items.quote: Gaal son of Ebed moved with his clan into Shechem, and its citizens put their confidence in him.
items.contrast: Gaal received the citizens’ confidence; Zebul is mentioned only as Abimelek’s deputy.
items.reason: The reader must resolve “him” as Gaal and connect that earlier event to the later festival. The window explicitly identifies Gaal as the person trusted, so the key is complete and unique.
